question_text: Compare clustering and association-rule discovery when analysing a retailer’s transaction data.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Clustering groups similar records/customers according to their features.; Its output is clusters rather than predefined outcome labels.; Association rules identify attributes/items that often occur together.; Its output is relationships such as purchases of A being associated with B.; Both can explore patterns without preassigned target class labels.; Neither technique alone establishes causation; outputs and use cases differ, so the choice depends on the analytical goal.
